page_title: HEI 1-2 EIN | Heidenheim v Eintracht Frankfurt 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.

90+8' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Kevin Trapp, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+6' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+5' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
90+3' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
90+2' Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
88' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Kevin Trapp punches the ball away.
87' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
86' The referee is firm and issues Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) a deserved yellow card.
85' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).
85' Substitution. Hrvoje Smolcic (Eintracht Frankfurt) has come on for Ansgar Knauff.
84' The ball goes out for a corner. Heidenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
84' Some great controlled play and passing from Heidenheim. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
83' The ball is cleared after Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

80' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
80' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
79' It is time for a substitution. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is on for Omar Marmoush.
78' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
77' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt).
76' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

76' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
75' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner.
72' Here is a change. Nikola Dovedan is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
70' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
69' Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
68' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) received a precise pass and hammers the ball at goal from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was a bit off and it flies just wide of the right post.
67' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Robin Koch.
65' Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner kick.
63' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
62' Soren Storks shows a yellow card to Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.

59' 1 - 2 Goal! Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom right corner. Kevin Trapp had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
58' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
57' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
54' The manager makes a subsitution with Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) coming on for Marnon Busch.
54' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Kevin Sessa is replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
54' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Benedikt Gimber can be given a rest.
52' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
48' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
47' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) tries to find Tim Kleindienst, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
46' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on the pitch for Philipp Max.
46' Half-time substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replaced by Hugo Larsson.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Soren Storks blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' The free kick from close range, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+2' Soren Storks blows his whistle and signals a foul after Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) brought his opponent down.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The referee awards a corner and Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) goes over to take it.
44' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
41' Some patient build-up play from Eintracht Frankfurt as they look to unlock the defence.
39' 0 - 1 Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) has scored an own goal! No one would like to be in his shoes right now.
37' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
37' A quickly taken corner by Heidenheim.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
35' Heidenheim are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
33' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
32' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
31' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Soren Storks had an easy-decision to make.
29' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball in, but Kevin Muller comfortably gathers the ball.
29' Half-chance! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a pass into the box, but Kevin Muller reacts well to snuff out the attack.
27' The Eintracht Frankfurt players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.

24' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
24' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
22' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
21' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
21' Eintracht Frankfurt string together a series of short passes.
19' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!

18' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Eintracht Frankfurt have a free kick from a promising distance.
15' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
12' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Soren Storks couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) and blew his whistle.
8' The free kick from long range, taken by Heidenheim, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.

6' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
5' Corner kick. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) is ready to send the ball into the box.
5' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
4' Heidenheim keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
2' The ball is behind the touchline and Heidenheim will take a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Eintracht Frankfurt will take the kick-off.
